test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some watches are belts.

Some belts are ties.

Conclusions:

(I) Some watches are ties.

(II) Some belts are watches.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusion I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8659156bf572d31f9c3e856a26cb989494e815766b2900ec6603ad89cbf0bdcc.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some watches are ties → Does not follow (As some watches are belts and some belts are ties. So it is possible but not definite.)

(II) Some belts are watches → Follow (As some watches are belts. As some part of watches is common with belts, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
